title: Release of Annual Report 2018-19 of IPC and Annual Performance Report 2018-19 of Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI) at Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi on 21.01.2020
bodyHtml:
Release of Annual Report 2018-19 of IPC and Annual Performance Report 2018-19 of Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI)

Ms Preeti Sudan, Secretary, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, released the “Annual Report 2018-19 of IPC and Annual Performance Report 2018-19 of Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI)” during the 18th Governing Body Meeting of IPC held on 21st January, 2020 at Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi in presence of Sh. Arun Singhal (Special Secretary), Prof. (Dr.) Rajiv Garg (Director General-DGHS), Dr. Dharmendra Singh Gangwar (AS&FA), Dr. Mandeep Kumar Bhandari (Joint Secretary-Drugs Regulation), Sh. Rajiv Wadhawan (Director-Drugs Regulation), Dr. VG Somani, Drugs Controller General (I), Dr. Jai Prakash, Secretary-cum-Scientific-Director (I/c), and IPC officials.
